players.bio: Brian To'o (born 18 August 1998) is a Samoa international rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. He won both the 2021 and the 2022 NRL Grand Finals with the Panthers. He has represented the NSW Blues in State of Origin and Samoa at Test and 9's level.

Dylan Edwards (born 10 January 1996) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL with whom he won the 2021 and 2022 NRL Edwards moved to Penrith, New South Wales to play for Penrith's S. G. Ball Cup team in 2013. In 2015 and 2016, he was a member of Penrith's NYC team.

Eddie Blacker (born 15 December 1999) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. Blacker previously played for the St George Illawarra Dragons in the National Rugby League.

Isaah Ferguson-Yeo (born 6 November 1994) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward and centre for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. Yeo was born in Dubbo, New South Wales, Australia. He is the son of former North Sydney Bears and Balmain Tigers player Justin Yeo.

Ivan Cleary (born 1 March 1971) is an Australian professional rugby league coach who is the head coach of the Penrith Panthers in the NRL and a former rugby league footballer who played as a fullback and centre in the 1990s and 2000s. He is a former head coach of the Wests Tigers, New Zealand Warriors and the Penrith Panthers.

Izack Tago (born 5 April 2002) is a Samoa international rugby league footballer who plays as a centre and second-row for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL In round 1 of the 2022 NRL season, Tago scored the first try of the year in the opening match as Penrith defeated Manly 28-6.

Jack Cogger (born 5 August 1997) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a five-eighth and halfback for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. In 2016, Cogger captained the Knights' NYC side. In round 10 of the 2016 NRL season, he made his NRL debut for the Knights against the Cronulla-Sutherland Sharks.

Jaeman Salmon (born 14 January 1999) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row or centre for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. He previously played for the Parramatta Eels in the National Rugby League.

James Fisher-Harris (born 5 January 1996) is a New Zealand professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop, lock and second-row forward for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL, and New Zealand and the New Zealand Māori at international level. He is a dual NRL premiership winning player of 2021 and 2022.

Jarome Luai (born 16 January 1997) is a Samoa international rugby league footballer who plays as a five-eighth or halfback for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. Luai played 33 games for the Penrith Panthers in the NYC between 2015 and 2017, scoring 13 tries and kicking 43 goals. Luai spent part of the 2017 season playing for Penrith in the New South Wales Cup.

Liam Martin (born March 5, 1997) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward and lock for the Penrith Panthers in the National Rugby League and Australia at international level. He won both the 2021 and the 2022 NRL Grand Finals with the Panthers. He has represented the NSW Blues in State of Origin.
Lindsay Smith (born 13 January 2000) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop or lock for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL.

Luke Garner (born 6 September 1995) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. On 24 June, Garner signed a two-year deal with Penrith starting in the 2023 NRL season.

Matt Eisenhuth (born 20 August 1992) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a lock for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. From 2010 to 2012, Eisenhuth played for the Parramatta Eels' NYC team. In 2010, he played for the Australian Schoolboys. In 2013, he graduated to the Eels' New South Wales Cup team, Wenworthville Magpies.
Mitchell Kenny (born 15 January 1998) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. He is a NRL premiership winning player of 2022.

Moses Leota (born 20 July 1995) is a New Zealand professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. Leota was born in Auckland, New Zealand. He is of Samoan descent and was raised in Penrith, New South Wales, Australia. He played his junior rugby league for the St Mary's Saints, before being signed by the Penrith Panthers.

Nathan Cleary (born 14 November 1997) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays for the Penrith Panthers in the National Rugby League (NRL), as a halfback. Cleary progressed through the Panthers' junior system, playing in their Harold Matthews Cup (under 16) and S. G. Ball Cup (under 18) teams, the latter of which he captained in 2015.

Soni Luke (born 25 February 1996) is a Tonga international rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. In round 7 of the 2022 NRL season, Luke made his first grade debut for the Penrith Panthers against the Canberra Raiders at Penrith Stadium. Luke spent the majority of the season playing for Penrith's NSW Cup team.

Spencer Leniu (born 8 September 2000) is a Samoa international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Penrith Panthers in the National Rugby League (NRL). Leniu was born in Auckland, New Zealand. Leniu grew up in Sydney, Australia and played for the Minchinbury Jets in the Penrith District Junior Rugby League.

Stephen Crichton (born 22 September 2000) is a Samoan professional rugby league footballer who plays as a centre for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL and Samoa at international level. He won both the 2021 and the 2022 NRL Grand Finals with the Panthers. He has represented the NSW Blues in State of Origin.

Sunia Turuva (born 4 September 2002) is a Fiji international rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback or winger for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. In November he was named in the 2021 RLWC Team of the Tournament.

Taylan 'Tiny' May (born 19 August 2001) is a Samoa international rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. In October May was named in the Samoa squad for the 2021 Rugby League World Cup. In the third group stage match at the 2021 Rugby League World Cup, May scored four tries for Samoa in their 62-4 victory over France.

Thomas Jenkins (born 16 March 2001) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a centre for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. In round 25 of the 2022 NRL season, Jenkins made his debut for the Panthers against the North Queensland Cowboys.

Tyrone Peachey (born 8 August 1991) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. Peachey previously played as a centre, second-row, lock, five-eighth, hooker and fullback for the Cronulla-Sutherland Sharks and the Penrith Panthers in the National Rugby League.

Zac Hosking (born 26 February 1997) is an Australian rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL. He previously played for the Brisbane Broncos in the National Rugby League. Hosking made his first grade debut for Brisbane against St. George Illawarra in round 17 of the 2022 NRL season.
